title: Professional Emails
ringkas: Subjek, salam, isi, penutup, lampiran, dan singkatan umum
goals: menulis **email profesional** dengan struktur yang jelas: subjek, salam, pembuka, isi, penutup
memakai ungkapan standar: [[I am writing to ...]], [[Please find attached ...]], [[I would appreciate it if ...]]
membedakan **formal** dan **semi-formal**, serta memilih salam dan penutup yang tepat
menghindari kesalahan umum pada email kerja

lesson.text: Email adalah cara komunikasi kerja yang paling sering dipakai. Email yang baik **singkat, jelas, dan sopan**, sehingga penerima langsung paham apa yang diminta. Di unit ini kamu belajar strukturnya dan ungkapan yang siap pakai.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur email profesional
table: [[I am writing to confirm our meeting.]]
[[Could you send me the report by Friday?]]
[[Please let me know if you have any questions.]]

lesson.title: Subjek yang baik
lesson.text: Subjek harus **spesifik dan singkat**: [[Invoice No. 245 – Payment Due 30 June]] lebih baik daripada [[Hello]] atau [[Important!!!]]. Penerima sering memutuskan membuka email hanya dari subjeknya.

items.ex: I'm following up on my last email.
I have an inquiry about the price.
I'm out of office until Monday.

lesson.title: 4. Ungkapan siap pakai
table: [[I am writing to inquire about ...]] / [[I am writing to confirm ...]]
[[Regarding your email of 5 May, ...]] / [[Further to our call, ...]]
[[Could you please send me ...?]] / [[I would appreciate it if you could ...]]
[[I would like to inform you that ...]]
[[I apologise for the delay in replying.]]
[[Please let me know if you need any further information.]] / [[I look forward to hearing from you.]]

lesson.title: 5. Singkatan umum
table: as soon as possible – secepat mungkin
end of day – akhir hari kerja
estimated time of arrival – perkiraan tiba/selesai

lesson.title: Hindari kesalahan umum
lesson.text: Jangan menulis dengan **HURUF KAPITAL SEMUA** (terkesan marah), jangan memakai terlalu banyak tanda seru, dan periksa **nama penerima** dan **lampiran** sebelum menekan Send. Gunakan [[Reply all]] hanya bila semua orang perlu membaca balasanmu.

lines.en: Good idea. Should I write in capital letters to show it's urgent?

lines.en: No, it may sound angry. Write 'by EOD today' instead.
lines.id: Jangan, nanti terdengar marah. Tulis saja 'by EOD today'.

items: Struktur: **Subject → Greeting → Opening → Body → Closing → Sign-off**.
Formal: [[Dear Sir or Madam]] → [[Yours faithfully]]; tahu nama: [[Dear Mr. Adi]] → [[Yours sincerely]] / [[Kind regards]].
Siap pakai: [[I am writing to ...]], [[Please find attached ...]], [[I look forward to hearing from you.]]
Hindari huruf kapital semua dan subjek yang tidak jelas.

read.title: Reading an Email

read.id:
Email A berbunyi: "Kirim laporannya sekarang." Email B berbunyi: "Hai Anton, bisakah kamu mengirimkan laporan itu paling lambat pukul 3 sore hari ini? Aku membutuhkannya untuk rapat. Terima kasih!"
Email B lebih profesional. Email itu memakai salam, permintaan yang sopan, tenggat waktu, dan alasan. Email itu juga diakhiri dengan ucapan terima kasih. Baris subjek yang jelas, seperti "Laporan dibutuhkan pukul 3 sore", akan membuatnya lebih baik lagi.

qs.exp: Teks: "a greeting, a polite request, a deadline, and a reason."
options: A greeting, a polite request, a deadline, and a reason
Only a command and a sharp tone of voice
A joke, a story, and a long list of photos
A long story about the weekend and the weather

qs.exp: Email B: "I need it for the meeting."
qs.q: Why does Email B need the report?

qs.exp: Teks: "A clear subject line... would make it even better."
qs.q: What would make Email B even better?

read.text:
Email A says: "Send me the report now." Email B says: "Hi Anton, could you please send me the report by 3 p.m. today? I need it for the meeting. Thanks!"
Email B is more professional. It uses a greeting, a polite request, a deadline, and a reason. It also ends with a thank-you. A clear subject line, such as "Report needed by 3 p.m.", would make it even better.
